editorial_intent: Diagram the age-related mechanical decoupling between neural electrical slow-waves, cerebral vascular constriction, and low-frequency cerebrospinal fluid pulse waves during NREM sleep.
subject: A cross-sectional cerebral biomechanical schematic contrasting wide-amplitude fluid propulsion through patent vascular channels with diminished, high-resistance fluid wave attenuation through rigid, stiffened cerebral vessels.
setting: Frame featuring a geometric cranial meridian dome, a 24-division circadian astrolabe calibration arc, and a phase-coherent geodesic neural constellation woven into a Bauhaus lithographic grid.
composition: Asymmetric Post-Constructivist dual-panel lithograph layout depicting a top-to-bottom hydraulic sequence: high-amplitude electrical slow waves driving vascular contraction and fluid surge on the left, contrasting with dampened, out-of-phase fluid attenuation on the right.
